policy: Coverage, exact old outlines/hmtx/points/line, aliases and source preservation are mandatory. Pixel identity across expanded character coverage is an explicit diagnostic, not a mandatory requirement.
method: Pillow/FreeType BASIC native L masks, common baseline, fixed integer physical pixels; no resampling. Alpha64/128 crossings are diagnostics, not readability pass thresholds.

official_sources.supports: Available mapped reference glyphs supply extrema; implementation sorts samples and chooses central values. Internal values were not instrumented here.

official_sources.title: FreeType2.14.3 default automatic hint selection
official_sources.supports: A TrueType font without fpgm and with a sufficiently short prep table can use runtime autohint under default loading.

limits: The sampled control text does not exhaust every old glyph at every size/platform. These native FreeType results do not establish Chromium or device readability.

in_memory_causal_probe.scope: Display TTF angle U89D2 at32px; every modified font exists only in BytesIO and is discarded.
in_memory_causal_probe.maxp_restoration_not_attempted: Actual new glyph maxima and numGlyphs are retained; reducing them would contradict real outlines. The cmap-only restoration already keeps these fields unchanged.
in_memory_causal_probe.interpretation: On this measured FreeType build, changing only mapped character coverage can restore the old mask. 進過還 is a sufficient minimal combination on top of the old cmap; none of the three is individually necessary within the full new cmap. Official CJK-bottom sampling data contains these characters. Exact internal blue-zone values were not instrumented.
in_memory_causal_probe.not_a_delivery_change: Dropping requested mappings would defeat coverage. Dummy fpgm changes the renderer path and offset/size; it is diagnostic only and is never written to a font file.
